basic_details.job_title: NIOS Joint Director Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.post_name: Joint Director (Capacity Building Cell), Joint Director (Media)
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS), Noida, Uttar Pradesh, has invited applications for 2 posts in 2 roles under Advt No. NIOS/RC/05/2026. The posts include Joint Director (Capacity Building Cell), Joint Director (Media). Applications are accepted online until 9 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Submit the application online only at www.nios.ac.in or www.recruitment.nios.ac.in.
Pay the application fee online through the prescribed link in the online application.
Upload copies of certificates for qualification, date of birth and experience, no objection certificate (if working), scanned signature and passport size photograph.
Take a print out of the successfully submitted online application.
Send the print out with all uploaded documents by Speed Post to the Deputy Director (Admn.), Recruitment Section, NIOS, within seven days of submission.
Write 'Application for the post of ______' on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Second Class Master's Degree in any Subject from a recognized university; Officers holding analogous post with Rs.8700/- GP or five years experience in the scale of Level-12 of the Pay Matrix (78800-209200) in Central/State Govt. or Central/State Govt. Autonomous organization/University/Board dealing with Academic Administration, Planning, Preparation and Production of Self Learning Material/Text books in distance education and/or related areas; Experience of organizing training programmes, workshops, seminars, conferences in educational organizations; Working knowledge of Hindi and English. Experience required: Five years in the scale of Level-12 (or analogous post with Rs.8700/- GP) as printed. Age limit: Maximum 50 years. Pay: Level-13 (₹123100-215900). Qualification required: Master's Degree preferably in Mass Communication; A Post Graduate Degree/Diploma from a recognized University/Institute in production of Radio Programmes/Films. Experience required: Five years in the scale of Level-12 of the Pay Matrix (78800-209200) or 10 years in the scale of Level-11 (67700-208700) or equivalent in planning and executing Media Production. Age limit: Below 47 years. Pay: Level-13 (₹123100-215900).

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online through the prescribed link in the online application; ₹70/- online processing fee per transaction.

content_sections.heading: How Will NIOS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications Interview before the Selection Committee NIOS may restrict the number of candidates called for interview through shortlisting on well-defined criteria Candidates are shortlisted for interview on the information they provide A Screening Committee may be constituted to fix criteria for shortlisting Working candidates must bring No Objection/Cadre Clearance, with Vigilance Clearance and Integrity certified by the current employer, at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certificates for educational qualifications, date of birth and experience No objection certificate from present employer, if working Scanned signature and passport size photograph Disability certificate for PwD candidates claiming fee exemption Gazette Notification/Government order equating pay scale, for applicants from State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Organization/Universities where pay scales are not identical to Central Government Attested translation of certificates in a language other than English or Hindi

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIOS Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Submit the application online only at www.nios.ac.in or www.recruitment.nios.ac.in. Pay the application fee online through the prescribed link in the online application. Upload copies of certificates for qualification, date of birth and experience, no objection certificate (if working), scanned signature and passport size photograph. Take a print out of the successfully submitted online application. Send the print out with all uploaded documents by Speed Post to the Deputy Director (Admn.), Recruitment Section, NIOS, within seven days of submission. Write 'Application for the post of ______' on the envelope. Apply on or before 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Joint Director (Capacity Building Cell), 1 Joint Director (Media).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR & OBC: ₹1500. EWS, SC & ST: ₹750. PwD (minimum 40% disability): Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Joint Director (Capacity Building Cell): maximum 50 years; Joint Director (Media): below 47 years. Relaxation: General As per Govt. of India rules; maximum age on the crucial date not to exceed 56 years after relaxation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level-13 (₹123100-215900) for Joint Director (Capacity Building Cell), Level-13 (₹123100-215900) for Joint Director (Media).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Capacity Building Cell: Second Class Master's Degree in any subject from a recognized university, plus experience as printed. Media: Master's Degree preferably in Mass Communication, a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in production of Radio Programmes/Films, plus experience as printed. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Valid personal email ID required, to be kept active during the recruitment. OBC candidates belonging to the 'Creamy Layer' are not entitled to OBC concession.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have not acquired or will not acquire the educational qualification by the closing date need not apply.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Interview before the Selection Committee. NIOS may restrict the number of candidates called for interview through shortlisting on well-defined criteria. Candidates are shortlisted for interview on the information they provide.
